design_description: A stealth black design built around a tonal charcoal tiger-stripe pattern running across the entire jersey. The dark-on-dark treatment creates texture and aggression while keeping the overall look clean and premium. Metallic-gold detailing on the collar, shoulder stripes and sleeve cuffs provides a sharp contrast against the black base. Crest, branding and the bold YAPPERSFC wordmark are unified in gold for a strong, consistent identity. Overall, a powerful black-and-gold kit combining understated animal-inspired graphics with premium detailing.
